security_audit.summary: Static analysis flagged repository URLs, Markdown code fences, template placeholders, and expected document-generation file writes. Review found no hidden network calls, external command execution, runtime secret access, reconnaissance behavior, or prompt injection attempts.

remediation.issue: Optional generator overwrites fixed document filenames in the selected output directory.
remediation.suggestion: Add an overwrite warning or safe mode before replacing requirements.md, design.md, or tasks.md.

remediation.issue: Example deployment templates include secret-looking placeholder names.
remediation.suggestion: Label those values as examples and remind users not to commit real secrets.

content.user_title: Plan Software Projects With Structured Documents
content.value_statement: Software projects often fail when requirements, design choices, and tasks are unclear. This skill turns project ideas into structured planning documents for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
actual_capabilities: Creates requirements documents with user stories, acceptance criteria, glossary terms, and requirement IDs.
Creates system design documents with architecture, components, data flows, APIs, deployment, and testing sections.
Creates implementation plans with phases, tasks, dependencies, checkboxes, and requirement traceability.
Provides templates for web apps, APIs, CLI tools, microservices, data pipelines, and real-time systems.
Includes optional scripts for generating and validating planning documents.
limitations: It produces planning documents, not production application code.
It needs clear project goals, users, features, constraints, and technical preferences.
Generated examples require review before use in regulated or safety-critical domains.
Optional scripts write files locally when the user runs them.

use_cases.title: Start a new software product
use_cases.description: Turn a product idea into requirements, architecture, and a phased implementation plan before coding begins.

use_cases.title: Prepare AI-assisted implementation
use_cases.description: Create traceable documents that give Claude, Codex, or Claude Code clear implementation context.

use_cases.title: Standardize project documentation
use_cases.description: Use repeatable templates for requirements, design decisions, task breakdowns, and delivery tracking.

prompt_templates.title: Create a basic project plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a new project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a new software project named [project name]. Ask me for missing goals, users, features, constraints, and deployment needs.

prompt_templates.title: Generate the three core documents
prompt_templates.scenario: Create requirements, design, and tasks together.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create requirements, system design, and implementation plan documents for [project]. Include traceable requirement IDs and task dependencies.

prompt_templates.title: Expand an existing plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Improve project documents with a new feature.
prompt_templates.prompt: Add [feature] to my current project plan. Update requirements, design impacts, tasks, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Review architecture before implementation
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review for completeness and risk.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this project plan for missing components, unclear data flows, weak interfaces, hidden dependencies, and untestable acceptance criteria.

output_examples.input: I want to build a customer support portal for small teams.
output: A requirements document with support agent, customer, and administrator stories.
A design document covering authentication, ticket workflow, notifications, search, and deployment.
An implementation plan with setup, backend, frontend, testing, and release phases.

output_examples.input: Add real-time notifications to the plan.
output: New requirements for notification delivery, user preferences, retries, and failure handling.
Design updates for event flow, notification service boundaries, and monitoring.
Tasks for backend events, frontend alerts, tests, and rollout validation.

output_examples.input: Check whether my tasks cover every requirement.
output: A traceability review that identifies uncovered requirements.
Suggested task additions for missing implementation work.
Warnings for vague acceptance criteria or unclear dependencies.

best_practices: Provide target users, core features, deployment model, and constraints before asking for documents.
Review generated requirements with stakeholders before using them for implementation.
Keep requirement IDs, design components, and tasks synchronized as the project changes.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a full plan when the project goal is still undefined.
Do not treat generated estimates or phases as commitments without team review.
Do not skip acceptance criteria, because vague requirements weaken task planning.

faq.question: What documents does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates requirements, system design, and implementation plan documents in Markdown format.

faq.question: Does it write production code?
faq.answer: No. It plans the project and creates documentation that can guide later implementation.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude Code or Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The documents provide structured context for Claude Code, Codex, and other AI coding workflows.

faq.question: Does it support different project types?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes patterns for web apps, APIs, CLI tools, microservices, data pipelines, and real-time systems.

faq.question: Will it validate existing documents?
faq.answer: It includes guidance and an optional validator script for checking document completeness and traceability.

faq.question: Are the optional scripts required?
faq.answer: No. The skill can be used through prompts and templates without running local scripts.
